title: Screenshot Journaling

launchpad.outcome: Use your screenshot library: auto-captured BEFORE / ENTRY / AFTER shots, tags, and filters like “show me all my clean losers.”
launchpad.missionQuestion: What does my chart history actually show?

slides.title: Every rep, three pictures
lines: Shots from AGHF Replay are labeled automatically: date, instrument, timeframe, rep, study, stage. Shots from TradingView or live trading can be uploaded and attached to a rep or a new journal entry.
cards: The outcome and the structure it left

slides.title: Tag one screenshot
lines: Open any screenshot and add a tag. More than one is fine. Then try a quick filter.

takeaways: Tag them; filter them; find your patterns.
